item.name: Gateway
item.description: Use this folder for normal work. Everything goes through http://localhost:8000. The gateway verifies the JWT, adds X-User-Id and X-Internal-Key, and forwards to Auth, Tasks and Notifications. Run Login first, then Create task. The other folders call each service directly.

request.description: Gateway only. No auth.

item.name: Tasks
item.description: Direct calls to the Task service. X-Internal-Key and X-User-Id stand in for the API gateway, which will add them later. Run Create task first. Creating a task, and completing one, also creates a notification (see the Notifications folder).

request.description: Checks that the Task service and its database are up.
201. title is required; description, status (todo|doing|done) and due_date (YYYY-MM-DD) are optional. Saves the new id into 'taskId'.
Newest first. Tick the 'status' parameter to filter. limit is 1-100.
Send only the fields you want to change. Send null or an empty string to clear description or due_date.
Sets status to done.
204 with no body.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Direct calls to the Notification service. X-Internal-Key and X-User-Id stand in for the API gateway.

request.description: Checks that the Notification service and its database are up.
Called by the Task service, not by users. Types: task.created, task.completed. Needs only X-Internal-Key. Creating or completing a task in the Tasks folder already sends these events by itself.
Newest first. meta.unread is the total number of unread notifications. Tick 'unread' to show only unread ones. Saves the newest id into 'notificationId'.
Marks the notification as read. Safe to call twice.
